caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden figure of a monkey standing upright, with its left arm bent across its chest and its right hand grasping a pole or stick that extends vertically along its body. The monkey has prominent facial features, including large, rounded ears, a pronounced brow, and a slightly open mouth showing its teeth. The texture of the carving is detailed, showing the grain and striations of the wood, as well as worn paint in multiple colors including shades of blue, red, yellow, and brown, giving the figure a weathered appearance. The base of the figure is also carved, with additional ornamental details visible. There is a metal ring or attachment on the monkey's left shoulder. The background is plain and cream-colored, and below the figure, the words "CIRCUS WAGON MONKEY" are written in capital letters.
title: Circus Wagon Monkey
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
